title: Python: D4 staticmethod in BUILTIN_INSTANCE_CLASSES is callable since 3.10
description: Reported by the Opus review of #150 (not yet probed): class D(staticmethod, B) resolves B.__call__ although staticmethod.__call__ wins on the MRO, so N3 gives a false edge. Decide whether staticmethod (and classmethod) leave the exemption set or the MRO order is read; fixtures; mutation checks.
